linkedin.headline: Founder | Ember & Oak Roasters
linkedin.about: I co-founded a small coffee roastery and I am obsessed with the craft. I am driven, warm and love a buzzy room, and I host regular tastings at the roastery. I collect vinyl and I cycle to work in all weathers. Looking for someone with ambition who also enjoys a lazy morning with great coffee.
